locationWhy: Clozest needs your location to show salons within {km} km. It is used only to find salons and is never shared.
gateTimeout: That took too long. Move near a window or turn on GPS, then try again.
gateUnavailable: Your phone couldn't find your location. Check that location is on, then try again.
gateUnsupported: This browser can't share a location. Open Clozest in Chrome or Safari.
guideIos1: Open the Settings app on your iPhone.
guideIos2: Tap Privacy & Security, then Location Services, and make sure it is on.
guideIos3: Scroll down to Safari Websites (or your browser) and choose "While Using the App".
guideIos4: Come back here and reload the page, then tap Try again.
guideAndroid1: Tap the icon at the left of the address bar (a lock or two sliders).
guideAndroid2: Tap Permissions, then Location, and choose Allow.
guideAndroid3: Check that Location is on in your phone’s quick settings (swipe down from the top).
guideAndroid4: Come back here and tap Try again.
guideDesktop1: Click the icon at the left of the address bar.
guideDesktop2: Find Location and set it to Allow.
guideDesktop3: Reload the page and click Try again.
guideDesktop4: For the best results, open Clozest on your phone: a computer can only guess your location.
locationOffHow: We can only show salons near you with your location. Here's how to turn it on:
noPlacesBody: Save Home, Work or any address to find salons near it, wherever you are.
placesFull: You've saved {max} places, the most there can be. Change or delete one to add another.
notSavedTitle: That place isn't saved any more
notSavedBody: It may have been deleted on another phone.
fullBody: That's the most there can be. Change or delete one to add another.
mapFailed: The map couldn't load. Your pin is kept and can be saved.
nameNeeded: Give this place a name, e.g. Gym.
homeTaken: You already have a Home address ({address}). Change that one, or save this as Other.
workTaken: You already have a Work address ({address}). Change that one, or save this as Other.
addressLineLabel: House or flat number, building, street
mapHintNoSearch: Tap Use current location when you are there, then drag the pin onto your building.
mapHint: Use your current location, or find the address on the map. Then drag the pin onto your building.
pinPrivacy: Salons are found around this pin; they never see your address.
needFields: Fill in the area, city and pincode above to find it on the map.
addressChanged: You changed the address. Tap Find on map again, or drag the pin.
locTimeout: That took too long. Turn on GPS and move near a window, then try again.
locUnavailable: Your phone couldn't find its location. Check that location is on.
locUnsupported: This browser can't share a location. Find the address on the map instead.
gpsAccuracy: GPS was accurate to about {metres} m.
movedFromGps: Moved {metres} m from the GPS point.
roughPin: The phone isn't sure where it is. Drag the pin onto your building, or try again near a window.
pinOutsideIndia: The pin must be in India.
locBlocked: Location is blocked for this site. Find the address on the map instead, or allow location in your browser.
pinNeeded: Put the pin on the map: use your current location or find the address.
deletedElsewhere: This place was deleted on another phone.
saveAsNew: Save it as a new place
deleteConfirm: Delete {place}? You can add it again any time.
guideApp2: Tap Apps (or See all apps), then Clozest.
guideApp3: Tap Permissions, then Location, and choose "Allow only while using the app".
guideApp4: Come back here and tap Try again.
locBlockedApp: Location is off for Clozest. Find the address on the map instead, or allow location in your phone's settings.
dragPinExact: Drag the pin onto your exact building, or tap the map where it is.
